item.title: Power outages hit counties, UPPCO outage map shows
item.description: The Upper Peninsula Power Company outage map shows that just under 5,000 customers in the county are experiencing an outage, a majority of whom are in Ishpeming and its surrounding townships.

item.title: California hardware store runs out of generators and propane as storm raises power outage fears
item.description: A hardware store in Campbell, California, ran out of generators and propane as Bay Area residents rushed to prepare for a storm threatening heavy rain, strong winds, and power outages. Flooding and downed trees were among the concerns as forecasts warned of possible thunderstorms and dangerous coastal surf, according to NBC Bay Area.

item.title: Outages leave over 12,500 customers in Monterey County and Santa Cruz County without power
item.description: More than 2,700 customers were without power in Monterey and Santa Cruz counties Wednesday afternoon, according to PG&E outage data.

item.title: Update: More power outages challenge Modesto Irrigation District
item.description: A 3:20 p.m. update from the Modesto Irrigation District reports 1,621 customers without power. There are 12 areas of power failure. The largest is 1,100 south of Dry Creek and Thousand Oaks and East La Loma parks. That outage struck at 2:37 p.m.

item.title: Widespread Outages Got You Thinking About Emergency Prep? Here’s Our Expert Advice.
